bio: The busy port city of Klaipėda plays host to this cosy restaurant where, once you’ve located the discreet entrance – a very warm welcome awaits. As you step over the threshold, a feeling of calm engulfs you, and you can drift away from the world outside. Lunch is a simple affair and represents great value, while at dinner, honest flavours shine through in modern dishes where fish is a highlight, such as in the roasted cod with coco beans, chorizo and cauliflower. This will quickly become one of your favourite new places to eat....
